summary: I re-tested 'Hapus laporan' and 'Pulihkan data' now that the email code step is gone. Backend: 12/12 pytest tests pass. Frontend: every requested flow passed in the Playwright UI tests. The purge modal shows only the mode buttons plus 'Hapus N data' and 'Unduh Excel'. It has no code input and the word 'kode' does not appear anywhere. 'Unduh Excel' downloaded laporan-masuk-Tahun_2024.xlsx and the modal stayed open with no rows deleted. 'Hapus' opens a browser confirm and then deletes. Year 2024 on Buku masuk deleted 6 rows and the toast appeared. Ticking 2 transaksi rows deleted only those 2, and the paired return records were removed too. Rentang mode on Pengunjung (01-03-2024 to 30-04-2024) deleted 2 rows. The 'Periksa' button stays disabled until both dates are set. The checkbox for the active loan is disabled, and the year preview reports '1 data tidak ikut dihapus (buku masih dipinjam)'. Petugas gets 403. Restore: I downloaded a backup with backup-data-button, then picked it in restore-file-input. A browser confirm appeared, then the upload ran with progress shown, with no code box. It finished with 'Selesai: 32 entri dipulihkan', the data counts were unchanged and login still worked. Both POST /admin/restore/start (chunked upload) and POST /admin/restore (single upload) work without a code. An invalid file returns 400 and existing data is left alone. I did not trigger Reset data.

minor.issue: The old regression tests test_purge_wrong_code and test_code_single_use still expect the code-based purge. They will fail now that the purge succeeds without a code. They should be removed or updated.

action_items: Remove or update the obsolete code-based tests in /app/backend/tests/test_report_purge.py (test_purge_wrong_code, test_code_single_use and the seed('code') calls)

Optional cleanup: remove the unused `code` fields (PurgeInput.code, StartInput.code, the restore_once Form code) and the unused verify_reset_code parameter from purge.build_router and restore_big.build_router
critical_code_review_comments: purge.py: PurgeInput.code is accepted but ignored, and the verify_reset_code dependency is never used. This is dead code.
restore_big.py: StartInput.code and the restore_once `code` Form field are left over and unused.
Purge happens in one step with no undo (as the user asked). The window.confirm text clearly warns that it cannot be undone. Deletions are recorded in purge_logs.
seed_data_creation: I re-ran seed_old_reports.py at the end, so the 2024 sample rows (6 of each type) are present again. The restore used a fresh backup of the current data, so no data was lost.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Purge and restore no longer need an email code. Use the regression file test_purge_restore_nocode.py; test_report_purge.py still contains obsolete code-based tests. The environment clock reads Nov 2026. Do not trigger reset-data-button, because it emails the real owner.
